title: The JSON answer of POST /send
description: 200 with {"status": "sent"} once every part went out, and an otp_request for a message that asks for a one-time code, else an error with the status docs/API.md lists. The guards in front of it (421 for another Host, 403 for a write from a web page) answer in plain text instead. Keys are added, never renamed or removed: a reader ignores those it does not know. This schema describes exactly the answers this version gives, and refuses any other key so that tests hold it to the code: a client validating against it should allow unknown keys, as later versions add them.

otp_request.description: For a message that asks for a one-time code the OTP guard would catch: an id, which the hand-off of the code repeats.
